en: A black-and-white photograph of a mid-20th-century building with a distinctive sloped metal roof and wooden siding on the upper floor. There is a stone chimney on the right side, barred windows on the lower floor, and a small balcony. A boxy delivery van, likely from the 1960s or 1970s, is parked in the driveway. The area looks residential, with a small patch of lawn and another house visible in the background.
